summary: UY Scuti Acquisition Corp., a Cayman blank-check vehicle listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K reporting a joinder agreement and first amendment to its previously announced July 18, 2025 merger agreement with Isdera Group Limited. Isdera Inc. and Isdera Technology Limited were joined as purchaser and merger sub, and Company Net Value was revised to $920 million. No per-share price, premium, or close date is stated in the excerpt. The filing is a SPAC de-SPAC step; watch for proxy timing, redemption levels, and any further amendments to deal terms.
